_comment: Mains' circuit map, and the ONLY hand-written list in the project.
It lists ROOTS, never files. What is inside a circuit is never enumerated
here and never cached; the filesystem answers every request at the moment
it is asked. Same reasoning as Marquee's venue.json: a list kept in a
folder nobody opens is a list that drifts.
NOTHING OUTSIDE A DECLARED CIRCUIT IS REACHABLE. There is no fallback
root, no parent-directory escape, and no 'serve everything under
Projects' mode. Adding a folder to the network is a deliberate act with a
line in this file, never an accident of where the server happens to sit.
That is the whole security model and it is worth more than any amount of
path filtering, because it fails closed.
Every root is validated on boot. A circuit whose folder has vanished is
reported as DEAD on the panel and returns 503 — it is never silently
dropped, because a missing room you can see is a bug report and a missing
room you cannot see is a mystery.
PORT 12060 is not arbitrary: 120 volts, 60 hertz.
Paths are relative to this file. Absolute paths are also accepted.
